description: AGSC-06-34 with AGSC-11-16 and AGSC-11-21, as amended 2026-11-10: the card lists every responder as an A2A interface and carries the a2a-card version as their protocolVersion, so it is written only when every responder is an A2A one (version a2a:<version>) and the a2a-card version is a bare A2A version. In mcp-responder the responder is an MCP server, and in version-not-bare the a2a-card version is a2a:1.0: no card is written, the warning AGSC-E210 says why, and the discovery document does not declare a2a-card, which the node does not serve. In a2a-responder the card is written and declared. Beside disc-0031, which covers a card with no responder. Derived by hand from the rules.
